description: Data flows. You need to know the path, the changes, and the reasons. ChartExpo Sankey Diagram for Power BI reveal movements — money, people, resources, and beyond — in a clear view. Track drop-offs, follow conversions, and map processes without coding or clutter in the flow diagram. Watch the flow. Spot the gaps. Act with confidence. Sankey Chart Features: Up to 15 Levels: Visualize data across as many as 15 levels. Easy to Use: Create charts in a few clicks inside Power BI. Secure Data: Everything stays in Power BI; no data leaves. Customization: Adjust node size, spacing, visibility, and interactions for clarity. Multi-Level Support: Show complex flows across hierarchies. Labels & Stats: Edit fonts and display stats on nodes or links. Label Position: Place labels on the left or right of nodes. Conditional Formatting: Spot outliers with rules on values, ranks, or percentages. Null/Blank Nodes: Hide null nodes instantly. Sorting: Arrange nodes by order or level. Cross Highlighting: Interact with other visuals; selections refresh the Sankey chart. Highlight Path: Hover on any node to trace the flow back to the first level. Business Use Cases: Finance Teams Cash flow, fund flow, expenses, and profit & loss. Track income vs. expenses and see where money goes. Marketing Teams Customer journeys, campaigns, and website traffic. Spot which campaigns work and where visitors drop.…
